scenes.title: Biggest tire on a stock Suzuki SJ / Samurai?
215/75R15
scenes.body: Zukiworld owners: 215/75R15 fits with no modifications; 225s with a little effort.

scenes.title: 235/75R15 (≈29 in)
scenes.body: Needs trimming or a 1.5–2 in lift; flatten the inner fender seams.

scenes.title: 31 in
scenes.body: Trail Tough's deluxe SPOA kit is rated for up to 31 in tires, with knuckle-over steering.
